subject: Step28 runtime is anomalously slow; token load and active throttling ruled out
body: Lane B read the shared WorkBridge process output read-only. Lane A step28 reached 1/8 at 386.27 s and 2/8 at 717 s (~354.08 s/step running average), materially slower than prior 8-step receipts (~86-110 s/step). CPU-side token audit rules out a heavier window: rows160-223 total ~15,222 capped tokens / mean 237.84, versus rows96-159 ~15,959 / mean 249.36; max 482 vs 510. Current GPU telemetry also does not show active throttling: P0, SM ~1987 MHz, 100% utilization, no active HW/SW thermal or power slowdown; temp 83-84C vs 87C target. Current log explicitly reports both causal_conv1d and chunk_gated_delta_rule on reference PyTorch fallbacks. Hostile conclusion: do not interpret step28 wall time as data complexity. Preserve the run if mechanically healthy, but capture this runtime anomaly in the receipt/analysis and do not use step28 timing as a clean BNB8 baseline for Lane B optimizer comparison.
